method: Each entry below was read directly from the carrier's/retailer's own site via WebFetch on 2026-10-06, with the quote taken from that fetch. Entries where the official page could not be fetched (403/Access Denied, JS-only Lightning page, blocked certificate, or the fetch returned no relevant text) are listed in notFound with the reason, and are NOT guessed from memory.

carriers.heldAt: nearby FedEx location (e.g. FedEx Office, Walgreens, FedEx OnSite) or FedEx facility
carriers.after: returned to the nearest FedEx facility or shipper
carriers.quote: If a package can't be left at a residential address (e.g., it requires a signature or the driver can't find a secure spot), we'll deliver it to a nearby FedEx location. ... It will be held for pickup as early as the same day of your missed delivery attempt. Packages not picked up within 7 days will be returned to the nearest FedEx facility or shipper.

carriers.heldAt: nearby FedEx or FedEx OnSite location
carriers.quote: FedEx might make additional attempts to deliver your package, or for residential addresses; it may be redirected to a nearby FedEx or FedEx OnSite location for customer pickup. FedEx will hold your package for up to 5 business days for FedEx Ground or FedEx Express before it is returned to the shipper.

We'll make a delivery attempt at the addressee's door. If no one is available, we'll leave a Delivery Notice Card at the door. ... We use a Delivery Notice Card to show that the item is available for pickup at a nearby post office. ... We'll hold the item at the post office for 15 calendar days, after which time we'll return it to the sender.

carriers.after: returned to the sender if there is a legible return address
carriers.quote: 'Sorry we missed you' notice (also called a 'Docket In Box or DIB notice'). An Post retains missed deliveries for: 5 working days for Standard and Express Post, 3 working days for registered post, 16 working days for items received from abroad. After the holding period expires, the postal service attempts to return the item to the sender if there's a legible address on the outside. When returned, a sticker explaining why we couldn't deliver it is attached to the package.
carriers.note: holdDays given (5) is for Standard/Express Post; registered post is 3 days, items from abroad 16 days.

carriers.heldAt: Estafeta branch (sucursal) chosen by the customer
carriers.after: held at the branch as a pickup service; no hold-day figure found on this page
carriers.quote: We will make a second delivery attempt the next business day according to the frequency of your zip code. ... If it is not possible to complete the delivery, you can generate a report to coordinate your shipment to the Estafeta branch of your preference.

bulky.ifNobodyHome: A second delivery attempt is scheduled for the next available date; if that second attempt also fails, the order is cancelled and refunded.
bulky.quote: if you are not present during the scheduled delivery time, you may be subject to a re-delivery fee. ... If the TSP is unable to complete the Delivery Services due to you or your representative not being home or due to you providing us with incomplete or incorrect delivery information, a second attempt will be made for the next available date. We will inform you of the new delivery date. ... If the second attempt to deliver is also unsuccessful, your order will be cancelled, and the cost of the associated IKEA product(s) will be refunded to you, using your original payment method.

bulky.ifNobodyHome: John Lewis contacts the customer to reschedule for a more convenient time; no fee mentioned on the fetched page.
bulky.quote: If no one is available at the provided address to accept the delivery, we will contact you to reschedule.

bulky.ifNobodyHome: Best Buy calls ahead of scheduled appliance/TV/furniture delivery; if there's no one at home the delivery is rescheduled rather than left unattended, since someone must sign.
bulky.quote: If you need to reschedule for a different day, you can do that online.
bulky.note: This exact sentence is the only directly-fetched quote from the official help page; the no-one-home mechanics (call ahead, must reschedule, must be 18+) came from a Best Buy community Q&A page rather than the policy page itself, so is not included as an official quote.

signatureRequired.quote: Most shipments require a signature for delivery.
